title: Keep project memories tidy as we go: durable rules in memory, working state on items
outcome: Agents know the simple practice from the instructions they already read, so project memories stay tidy without another bulk cleanup, a new gate, a hard limit or an extra system.
acceptance: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md carry the 'Keeping project memories tidy' text both projects' coordinators concurred on, word for word, under their Engram work tracker sections, and no test reads those files.
Engram's coordinator has adopted the same text for Engram in its own instructions.
Greg is told exactly what was put in place and when each part took effect.
